title: NBA: Raptors upset Pistons, Harden scores 51 in Cavs win
summary: The Toronto Raptors upset the Detroit Pistons 105-102 in the NBA Cup on Friday as James Harden delivered a blockbuster 51-point performance in Cleveland's victory over the Indiana Pacers.
